# istio_proxy_config (Resource)

Manages an Istio ProxyConfig resource. ProxyConfigs provide per-workload proxy configuration as a CRD-based alternative to annotations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_proxy_config" "concurrency" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "networking.istio.io/v1beta1"
    kind       = "ProxyConfig"
    metadata = {
      name      = "high-concurrency"
      namespace = "default"
    }
    spec = {
      selector = {
        matchLabels = {
          app = "my-app"
        }
      }
      concurrency = 4
      environmentVariables = {
        ISTIO_META_DNS_CAPTURE = "true"
      }
    }
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full ProxyConfig manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `networking.istio.io/v1beta1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
